products.name: Surfer SEO
products.note: SEO optimization AI; content scoring; NLP analysis; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Surfer is an SEO and content optimization company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Wrocław, Poland. Its platform, which it describes as an "AI Visibility Platform," is aimed at marketing and SEO teams and is designed to help brands improve their presence in both traditional search engines and AI-driven search tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude. The company says it analyzes signals that determine how content is cited or ranked by large language models, focusing on structure, depth, and credibility rather than conventional keyword density.

The core product, Surfer SEO, combines content writing and editing tools with real-time SEO scoring, NLP analysis, keyword research, competitive analysis, and monitoring of AI search visibility. The platform includes features for generating and editing content, tracking when competitor pages displace a user's content in search or AI answers, and building programmatic pages. EU-hosted options are available. One user quoted on the site describes more than doubling blog content production while reducing the cost to produce SEO content by more than four times. The site also offers supplementary free tools including an AI writing tool, an AI detector, and an AI humanizer, as well as a Chrome extension.

The held facts record no litigation and no MCP server presence. The company's profile on this site was verified in August 2026.
